photos.title: South Carolina State House in Columbia, south portico
photos.what: The South Carolina State House in Columbia seen from the south: a granite building with a columned portico, a wide stair, a copper dome with the U.S. and South Carolina flags, palmetto trees, and an office tower behind it on the left. No person is the subject; no one in the frame can be recognized.
photos.caption: The South Carolina State House in Columbia, where the General Assembly meets.
photos.alt: The South Carolina State House in Columbia, a granite building with tall columns, a wide stair and a copper dome under a blue sky
